behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
behaviors.trigger: Leader proposal; Replicate or ReplicateResp delivery
implementation_guards: Peer.Handle rejects responses from unknown members; leader response wrapper requires a remote, observer or witness record.
Follower requires matching previous log term; conflicting committed entries panic; commitment is monotonic.
Leader selects quorum match from voters and witnesses, excluding observers; entryLog.tryCommit requires the selected entry term to equal the current term.
writes: Proposal entries receive current term and consecutive indices; local match advances.
Successful replication response advances sender progress; commitment advancement broadcasts replication. Rejections may decrease next and retry.
async_boundaries: Messages are queued in raft.msgs; engine persists updates and sends replies later.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft state transition and election handlers
behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
behaviors.trigger: Election, vote request/response, or differing message term
implementation_guards: Campaign is suppressed while committed entries exceed applied position; vote requires eligibility under previous vote and up-to-date log.
Unknown response senders are filtered by Peer.Handle and observer vote responses are rejected by candidate handler.
Higher-term vote requests can be ignored during a recent-leader check-quorum interval; other higher terms change authority; lower-term messages are ignored.
writes: Candidate increments term and votes for self; a quorum of votes promotes it.
Reset clears election votes, pending read-index tracker, leader transfer and remote progress; term change clears persistent vote. Log and committed prefix survive reset.
New leader scans unapplied configuration entries and appends a current-term empty entry.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Fresh remote progress and current-term commitment prevent simply reusing a previous leader replication tally.

behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
writes: Add/promote/remove modifies membership maps; observer promotion inherits its replication progress.
Removal of local leader steps down. Removing another member can immediately recompute commitment and broadcast.
Rejected configuration clears Raft pending-change state through node.configChangeProcessed; accepted configuration changes registry and Raft membership.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Membership controls quorum and eligible replication progress.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Local removal ends leadership and applied position gates campaigning.

implementation_guards: RSM rejects stale ordered ConfigChangeId, reuse of removed IDs, duplicate membership/address, invalid role conversion and removal of the last full member.

RSM configChange updates membership and internal applied position before node.ApplyConfigChange; visible lastApplied is published after handling the task batch. Node updates Raft membership under raftMu before that publication is consumed by updateAppliedIndex.

behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
writes: GetUpdate collects state, messages, unstable entries, committed entries and snapshot. Commit marks the processed update and clears outgoing buffers.
durable_effects: ILogDB requires atomic saving of state, log entries and snapshot metadata. ShardedDB routes the update batch to db.saveRaftState, which adds these components to a write batch and calls CommitWriteBatch.
external_effects: Replicate/Ping messages may be sent before SaveRaftState. FastApply can enqueue committed work before save only when setFastApply permits it; overlapping unstable entries disable FastApply.
Other messages are sent by processRaftUpdate after SaveRaftState.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reply transmission follows persistence call; replication transmission has a separate earlier path.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Committed entries are queued for application, with a FastApply branch.

unknowns: KV-specific synchronization and crash durability details remain open; ordinary reload mechanism is mapped in B-reload.

behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
implementation_guards: Reject snapshot index at or below committed. Matching local index/term advances commitment without replacing the log.
writes: Unmatched newer snapshot restores log committed/processed positions. restoreRemotes separately rebuilds membership and progress from snapshot membership.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Snapshot can establish a committed prefix.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Restored membership can promote an observer or remove leader authority.

unknowns: On-disk imported snapshot variants and interrupted filesystem installation are not yet followed.
async_boundaries: Persisted snapshot update queues an RSM recovery task. RSM task handling drains preceding entries before returning a snapshot task.
StateMachine.Recover loads state/session data and installs snapshot membership/applied position, then calls node.RestoreRemotes under raftMu before returning.
node.recoverDone notifies recovery completion and wakes application worker; recovery status blocks further task handling until completion, and initial completion marks node initialized.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft leader read-index handler and readIndex tracker
behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex request and matching heartbeat confirmation
implementation_guards: Multi-voter leader requires a committed entry in its current term. Context-bearing heartbeats go to voters and witnesses.
Tracker deduplicates contexts and confirmations by sender; confirmation counts leader implicitly.
writes: Records requesting node, context and committed index. Quorum confirmation releases queued requests through the confirmed context and rewrites released indices to that context index.
external_effects: Local completions use each released request context. Remote ReadIndexResp uses each released request destination and index but the confirming message Hint/HintHigh.
unknowns: Can a legal overlapping remote request history expose the per-request versus confirming-context difference through emitted responses and recipient ReadyToReads?
important_branches: Follower forwards its context unchanged to the known leader; send fills source replica ID. A received ReadIndexResp becomes ReadyToRead with exactly the received context.
A single-voter leader completes local requests directly and sends matching-context responses for observer requests; the question concerns multi-voter queued confirmation.

behaviors.protocol_context: One cluster replica and its current term, log and membership
behaviors.trigger: Engine processes updates or node observes applied index
external_effects: Committed entries are pushed to application queue. ReadyToReads are passed to pendingReadIndexes and checked against LastApplied.
handleEvents updates applied position and rechecks pending reads after events.

RSM Handle drains tasks in order and signals StepReady when processed. Entry dispatch applies state machine updates or session/configuration operations; session cache can return prior results without reapplying commands.

Normal updates invoke node.ApplyUpdate to correlate clientID/seriesID/key and notify results. Visible lastApplied is published after the handled batch; node reads it under the RSM lock and passes it to Raft.
unknowns: Concurrent and on-disk application variants have only representative coverage.

writes: replayLog installs latest snapshot in LogReader, reads persisted Raft state after snapshot index, and sets log range. newRaft obtains state/membership from NodeState, loads term/vote/commit and enters follower/observer/witness state, resetting volatile tallies.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Restores committed prefix rather than old volatile match tallies.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Term and vote survive reload while active leadership does not.

unknowns: KV-specific crash behavior and bootstrap variants remain open.

behaviors.trigger: Client read batch admission, ReadyToRead, applied notification, timeout or close
writes: Each batch receives a nonzero random Low context and logical-clock High; separate batches can coexist.
addReady updates only the batch keyed by the exact received context. applied completes it only when index > 0, index <= applied and deadline has not elapsed; other contexts do not release it.
external_effects: Completion marks RequestState ready for local reads; timeout and shutdown terminate pending requests.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Consumes the identity and index from leader-qualified read support via ReadyToRead; context substitution does not automatically satisfy an older batch.

unknowns: End-to-end timeout/retry consequence of a miscorrelated response is not yet executed.

facts.meaning: Replica current term and role provide the context used by term-qualified dispatch; term changes clear the vote and resets replace volatile support trackers.
facts.validity_context: Current in-memory raft term and role; membership is independently mutable.
facts.durability: Term and vote are exposed in Update.State; actual durability is delegated to SaveRaftState and not yet traced.
facts.recovery: B-reload restores term/vote from LogReader state and enters a nonleader role; volatile trackers are reconstructed empty.

facts.meaning: Replica records a log prefix through committed as committed; leader quorum/current-term commitment, accepted leader replication/heartbeat and snapshot restore are distinct establishment paths.
facts.validity_context: Replica log history and current membership; not a statement of application completion or persisted backend state.
facts.durability: Exposed in raft State and saved through update processing; backend guarantee unread.
facts.recovery: B-reload restores persisted commit after installing snapshot/range; loadState checks commit lies within available log bounds.

facts.meaning: A pending read-index request retains its request context, origin and sampled committed index until confirmation removes it; this does not establish remote response correlation.
facts.validity_context: One leader readIndex instance between resets; indices may be raised when a later queued context confirms.
facts.recovery: Not restored; client completion/retry behavior unread.

surfaces.reason: Sourced local/remote context handling difference when confirm releases multiple queued requests; obligation and legal history unresolved.

surfaces.entry_point: RSM recovery and membership application callbacks
surfaces.reason: Representative recovery, membership application and visible applied-index handoff now traced; storage crash variants remain open details.

formation.explanation: Leader assigns term/index to proposals, followers validate previous log term and protect committed history, and eligible member responses advance replication progress. Voter/witness quorum match plus current-term log check advances leader commitment, propagated through replication and bounded heartbeat commit. Engine splits early replication from post-save replies and queues committed work for application. RSM processes committed entries in order, validates configuration changes, manages client sessions and invokes application/completion callbacks; its visible applied position is published after the batch and fed back to Raft.

context.explanation: Election establishes a new term and self vote; up-to-date eligible voting responses establish leadership. Term dispatch rejects stale messages and resets volatile support on authority changes. Peer filters unknown response senders before raft dispatch. Membership application can remove leadership or promote observers. Restart loads persisted term/vote/commit, enters a nonleader role and later restores state-machine snapshot membership before initialization completes.

connection.explanation: Committed history survives role reset while vote tallies, replication match and pending read-index trackers do not. New leaders append a current-term entry before quorum-dependent reads can proceed. Campaigning waits for committed work to be applied, guarding stale membership; membership changes alter eligible support and removal can trigger a new commitment calculation. Configuration membership is updated under raftMu before the RSM publishes the applied batch position used by the election guard. Snapshot recovery installs state/session/membership before RestoreRemotes and recovery completion, while restart restores persisted term/vote/commit but no old leadership or volatile support. Read requests retain context across forwarding, and recipient completion requires the exact returned context plus application through the confirmed index.

open_details: Remote queued read-index response context differs from the released request context; exact consumer matching is established, but a legal overlapping execution and correspondence remain outstanding.
KV-specific crash durability, imported/on-disk recovery variants and deeper configuration histories remain open.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority, persistence/reload, recovery, membership and consumption relationships are sourced; focused questions and deeper variants remain open.
